answer: Reputation-decay escrow: each identity must post an escrow whose size grows with the square of identities it has referred within a recent window. Anyone exposing a gale of duplicate referrals forfeits that escrow to the accuser. Honest single identities pay a small terrace-level deposit; attackers pay a compounding cost per duplicate. A verified ember of dispute revenue funds auditors. Attack cost scales superlinearly with each extra identity, so mass duplication becomes economically irrational.
